• Leukotrienes are chemical mediators produced by the 
body that contribute to the development of asthma. 
Leukotrienes, which are synthesized from arachidonic 
acid, modulate the inﬂ ammatory response resulting in
tissue edema, mucus secretion, smooth-muscle prolif-
eration, and powerful bronchoconstriction. One possible
approach to preventing the synthesis of leukotrienes is
through dietary modiﬁ cation. Normally, human inﬂ am-
matory cells contain high ratios of omega-6 fatty acid
(arachidonic acid) to omega-3 fatty acids. Because a
common pathway metabolizes both of these fatty acids, 
an excess of omega-3 fatty acids interferes with the
metabolism of the omega-6 fatty acids and reduces their 
incorporation into tissue lipids.
